paragraphs.text: Ratadrabik of Urborg is a powerful lich who resides on Dominaria .

Ratadrabik is one of the oldest and most enduring liches known to Dominaria. From his decrepit fortress hidden deep within the marshes of Urborg , he has witnessed countless cataclysms, including the devastation of a Phyrexian invasion and even the fracturing of time itself . Throughout these trials, he has survived attacks by various heroes and challengers who sought to end his reign. Today, no necromancer on Dominaria rivals Ratadrabik’s dark power—except perhaps the spirit -speaker Moira , who appears to prefer allowing the restless ghosts and ghouls of Urborg to run wild rather than submit to their rightful master. Should Ratadrabik succeed, he intends to solidify his position as the supreme dark force within Urborg.
